newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Plastics makes US$100 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Royal Plastics makes US$100 mln placement.

text.p: Royal Plastics Group Ltd said on Thursday it received about US$100 million in proceeds from U.S. institutional investors from the private placement of senior unsecured notes maturing August 2006.
Royal Plastics said the proceeds were used to repay debt outstanding under its revolving bank credit facilities, the authorized amount of which remains unchanged at C$375 million.
It said it anticipates the credit facilities will be virtually unutlized as at September 30, 1996, Royal's year end.
